name: A plan line's semi-additive EOM stock snapshot timestamp as_of must equal the exact final UTC second of its proleptic Gregorian calendar month (Feb 28 in non-leap years, Feb 29 in leap years).

payload.rationale: A plan line's semi-additive EOM stock snapshot timestamp as_of must equal the exact final UTC second of its proleptic Gregorian calendar month (Feb 28 in non-leap years, Feb 29 in leap years).

response.expression: all([days_between(date(take(self.plan_month, 4) + '-03-01'), date(self.period_month_date))] as b0, seconds_between(timestamp(self.period_start), timestamp(self.as_of)) == ((((b0 == -28) ? 28 : ((b0 == -29) ? 29 : (((((b0 == 31) or (b0 == 92)) or (b0 == 184)) or (b0 == 245)) ? 30 : 31))) * 86400) - 1))
